scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma db push
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build: node init && cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
